summary.text: Brooke Dillon is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 77 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Meredith Craig.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Dillon described herself as a factory worker with a degree in animal sciences and said her main goals are solutions on affordability, healthcare and housing.

paragraphs.text: Brooke Dillon was born in Medina, Ohio, graduated from Buckeye High School and earned a bachelor's degree from The Ohio State University in 2014.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Dillon said her degree is in animal sciences with a minor in meat sciences, and that she has worked in an aftermarket parts distribution center for an access lift company, made livestock feed for nine years, and now inspects industrial tarp material.
She said she has worked on citizen-led ballot initiatives for three years and has done community volunteer work, including roadside cleanups and food drives.
Dillon advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026, receiving 4,258 votes in an uncontested race.
In her survey responses she named affordability, healthcare and housing as her key messages, along with support for Ohio farmers, respect for the will of voters, and limits on data centers.
She listed the Ohio Federation of Teachers as an endorser.
